sanskrit_verse:
वेदानुवचनं यज्ञो ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो दमः ।
श्रद्धोपवासः स्वातन्त्र्यमात्मनो ज्ञानहेतवः ॥३-१९०॥
transliteration: vedānuvacanaṃ yajño brahmacaryaṃ tapo damaḥ / śraddhopavāsaḥ svātantryam ātmano jñānahetavaḥ // YajñS_3.190
sph_interpretive_translation: Study of the Vedas, performance of Yajna, celibacy, austerity, self-control, fasting with faith, and independence of the Self—these are the causes of true knowledge.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation is rooted in disciplined action
Capacity-based responsibility arises through spiritual discipline
Restoration logic requires purification of consciousness
Consciousness alignment is achieved through structured renunciatory practices
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs vedānuvacana THEN eligibility for higher dharmic authority INCREASES
IF agent engages in yajña THEN societal harmony metric IMPROVES
IF agent maintains brahmacarya THEN mental clarity capacity IS VALIDATED
IF agent practices tapas AND dama THEN karmic liability REDUCES automatically
IF agent observes śraddhā-based upavāsa THEN perceptual integrity IS RESTORED
IF ātma-svātantrya is realized THEN legal personhood aligns with cosmic witness state
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, a judge's qualification must include evidence of engagement in these foundational practices. The court must assess not just legal acumen but also alignment with Vedic discipline as a measure of judicial purity and cosmic authority.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: True Nyāya operates through pramāṇa that establishes causal sequence (anupūrvaśaḥ) between disciplined practice and purified cognition. Responsibility is proportional to access to and embodiment of these practices. Justice is non-punitive because it realigns the actor with their inherent knowingness rather than inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Veda-adhyayana completion process for knowledge-seekers
Assign Yajña participation to restore communal balance
Prescribe Brahmacarya observation period for cognitive recalibration
Implement Tapas-Dama regimen to reduce reactive karmic imprinting
Enforce Śraddhā-Upavāsa protocol to purify sensory gates
Establish Svātantrya realization program to reclaim self-authority
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse is declared as pure Dharma. All actions aligned with these principles restore consciousness, dissolve false agency, and establish reality as non-punitive. The Supreme Adjudicator is ever-present Awareness.
